floodSeverity.label: Flood Severity (0–100)
floodSeverity.formula: Controls storm intensity scaling (0.65× to 1.25× depth multiplier) and onset threshold across Chatuchak canal vulnerability zones.

waterLevel.label: Simulated Water Level (m)
waterLevel.formula: Effective depth combines configured stage & rainfall with severity, canal water level, and effective drainage after pipe blockage (capped at 2.50 m).

affectedRoads.label: Total Affected Roads
affectedRoads.formula: Count of roads.geojson features where evaluated flood depth ≥ 0.04 m after bridge (+1.35 m) and arterial crown offsets.
affectedRoads.scope: Real roads.geojson geometry + simulated flood layer

affectedBuildings.label: Total Affected Buildings
affectedBuildings.formula: Count of buildings.geojson footprints intersecting the active target area with simulated surface depth ≥ 0.04 m.
affectedBuildings.scope: Real buildings.geojson footprints + simulated flood layer

affectedFacilities.label: Total Affected Facilities
affectedFacilities.formula: Stations from stations.geojson plus OSM-tagged civic amenities from buildings.geojson with simulated depth ≥ 0.04 m (elevated BTS/SRT use street-access reduction).

blockedSegments.label: Blocked Road Segments
blockedSegments.formula: Drivable road segments and directed graph links excluded from A* routing because local simulated depth meets/exceeds vehicle clearance limit.
blockedSegments.scope: A* road-graph edge state synchronized with Flood Impact

safeRoutes.label: Available Safe Routes
safeRoutes.formula: Connected emergency corridors out of 5 benchmark district origin–destination pairs passable under current flood depth without crossing blocked links.
safeRoutes.scope: Live A* pathfinder across Chatuchak road graph

trafficCongestion.label: Simulated Traffic Congestion (%)
trafficCongestion.formula: Simulated network congestion density controlling road speed reduction, congestion delays, and A* travel times.
trafficCongestion.scope: Simulated traffic model (not live sensor feeds)

waterStorage.label: Water Storage Utilization (%)
waterStorage.formula: Combined load index across Chatuchak khlong channels, retention park basins, and drainage deficit under active storm stage.
waterStorage.scope: Simulated canal, parks.geojson basins, and drainage state

powerOutageAreas.label: Simulated Power Outage Areas
powerOutageAreas.formula: Chatuchak GeoJSON sub-zones where simulated peak inundation ≥ 0.60 m triggers simulated distribution outage risk (SCADA telemetry absent).

dataNotes.canalVuln: Intersection uses Chatuchak canal-proximity vulnerability (no DEM elevation in source GeoJSON).
dataNotes.offsets: Elevated bridge/viaduct roads (1.35 m clearance), crowned primary/trunk arterials (0.50–0.75 m), and elevated BTS/SRT stations apply vertical drainage offsets.
dataNotes.facilitiesScope: Facilities come strictly from Chatuchak stations.geojson (20 stations) and tagged buildings.geojson amenities; hospitals/fire stations are absent from source polygons and are not fabricated.

mcda.title: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA)
mcda.subtitle: Constraint-gated weighted scoring · Preview on 3D city before confirmation
mcda.previewNotAppliedNote: Projected corridors and recovery markers are previewed on the left 3D viewport. Confirm explicitly below to mutate simulation state.
mcda.confirmApplyPrompt: Apply this confirmed solution to the live Chatuchak simulation? A revert snapshot will be saved automatically.
mcda.cannotApplyInfeasible: Cannot apply: this alternative failed hard operational constraints.
mcda.methodologyStep1: 1. Pre-Ranking Hard Constraint Gate: Every alternative is checked against receiving water capacity, blocked-road exclusion, and electrical fault isolation / donor MW limits before ranking. Failing options are excluded from #1 recommendation.
mcda.methodologyStep2: 2. Benefit/Cost Normalization & Weighted Sum (WSM): Each criterion is normalized 0–100 (benefit criteria score higher for larger gains; cost criteria score higher for lower time, risk, cost, or side-impact). Active weights automatically normalize to 100.0%.
mcda.simulatedDisclaimer: Notice: All projected deltas, discharge times, and scores are simulated estimates from the simplified Chatuchak city model.
mcda.noFeasibleSolutions: No candidate cleared all hard operational constraints. Resolve upstream blockages or isolate faults first.
mcda.aiNonScoringNotice: Non-scoring explainer — Gemini cannot alter MCDA scores, ranks, or constraint gates
